results.title: Nearly 20 new U.S. citizens take Oath of Allegiance at Tulsa's City Hall
results.description: Nearly 20 people from 10 countries took the Oath of Allegiance at a naturalization ceremony at Tulsa's City Hall on Thursday. The new citizens, including some who traveled from as far as Amarillo and Lubbock, Texas, left with resources on voting registration and financial literacy.

results.title: Cobb police chief to address Flock camera concerns at four town halls
results.description: In the midst of a growing debate over Flock Safety traffic cameras, Cobb Police Chief Dan Ferrell is scheduled to host four town hall meetings to help clear the air, the department announced Wednesday.

results.title: He’s impatient, erratic and scaring investors. It’s not Trump
results.description: A volatile president has introduced drastic reforms to fix a perceived crisis. No, this is not the US under its current leader, but Indonesia under Prabowo Subianto.
